MANUFACTURING INTEGRITY // 4-STAGE TECHNICAL WORKFLOW

The Industrial Production Process

Precision execution at every manufacturing milestone ensures maximum abrasion resistance, ergonomic grip comfort, and compliance with international PPE standards.

01 LEATHER-GRADE

Raw Material Selection

Grade-A Cowhide & Goatskin

Incoming leather hides undergo strict caliper thickness testing, tensile grading, and visual defect segregation before staging.

View Process Specs
02 DIE-CUTTING

Precision Die Cutting

Hydraulic Press & Laser Accuracy

Heavy-duty hydraulic clicker presses and laser-calibrated steel dies stamp ergonomic glove patterns with zero edge fraying.

View Process Specs
03 KEVLAR-JOIN

Industrial Sewing

Kevlar Thread & Reinforced Seams

Heavy-duty industrial lockstitch sewing using heat-resistant Kevlar thread, reinforced welting, and double-layered thumb crotches.

View Process Specs
04 QC-EXPORT

QC & Packaging

Pre-Shipment Compliance Check

Individual dimensional inspection, pair pairing, anti-mold conditioning, and export-compliant palletization for overseas freight.

View Process Specs

MANUFACTURING PROVENANCE // SAVAR, HEMAYETPUR

Dedicated Leather PPE Exporter with Direct Factory Control

MAX GLOVES BD LTD. operates a specialized 1,530 m² manufacturing plant in Savar, Hemayetpur, Bangladesh, supplying certified personal protective equipment to leading safety distributors across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

By controlling raw leather grading, precision die cutting, Kevlar-thread assembly, and export quality verification in-house, we eliminate intermediary costs while ensuring strict compliance with EN 388 mechanical and EN 407 thermal resistance standards.

OEM / ODM Customization Private labeling, custom leather dyeing, and bespoke cuff sizing.
Direct Export Procurement Transparent FOB pricing, rapid sample dispatch, and container shipping.
